posts.title: September pages from the gratitude journal
posts.description: 2026 has really been about using what I have and really live for the everyday moments. Here I finally went to have steak at Ashton's, a local casual dining chain. It wasn't the best but it was rather good for the price and the restaurant is located at a nearby mall so I can go again! *winks* And I also started using a really huge freebie tote that I got from a purchase. Hoarded it for a few months

posts.title: Eye drawings - one on the plane and one at home
posts.description: Still trying to get acquainted with the Caran d'Ache Luminance pencils. Brought them on last week's trip to Taipei and managed to get a quick eye drawn on the plane amidst turbulence. The colours are easy to blend and very vibrant. My only grouse is that it's really hard to pick the colours from a box/case because the colour indicator is just at the base of each pencil.

posts.title: Life is too short - use your supplies!
posts.description: Note to self: Life is too short - use your supplies! I've had these Caran d'Ache Luminance pencils for a couple of years but have never used them. They were pricey ($7/pc) so I was reluctant to use them. But that has changed. All 40 of them are now packed in my travel kit. After I drew this eye.:)
